question: In 2020, who among the following became the most successful F1 driver with the most career wins, overtaking Michael Schumacher?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lewis Hamilton**__.

__
 
• **In 2020, Lewis Hamilton became the most successful F1 driver with the most career wins, overtaking Michael Schumacher**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Six-times world champion Lewis Hamilton** became the most successful** Formula One driver** of all time in terms of race **wins **with a dominant **92nd career victory** at the **Portuguese Grand Prix**.

 
 
• **Lewis Hamilton** was born on** 7 January 1985 **in **Stevenage, Hertfordshire, England**.
 
• He currently competes in** Formula One for Mercedes,** having previously driven for **McLaren **from **2007 to 2012**.
 
• Hamilton began his car racing career in the **2001 British Formula Renault Winter Series**, finishing fifth in the standings.
